% LaTeX's \newtheorem, without amsthm or ntheorem. A numbered theorem, one
% with a note, a lemma that shares its counter, and a remark numbered
% within sections each have a link at their head, where a \ref to them
% leads.
\documentclass{article}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newtheorem{remark}{Remark}[section]
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem}\label{thm:one}A numbered theorem.\end{theorem}
\begin{theorem}[A note]\label{thm:note}Another, with a note.\end{theorem}
\begin{lemma}\label{lem:one}A lemma.\end{lemma}
\begin{remark}\label{rem:one}A remark.\end{remark}
Theorem~\ref{thm:one}, Theorem~\ref{thm:note}, Lemma~\ref{lem:one} and
Remark~\ref{rem:one}.
\end{document}
